list_to_padded: create a padded tensor from a list of variable-sized PyTorch tensors with a specified pad value
padded_to_list: convert a padded tensor back into a list of tensors using split sizes to trim padding
list_to_packed: pack a list of tensors into a single concatenated tensor with index mapping metadata
packed_to_list: split a packed tensor back into a list of tensors using specified split sizes
padded_to_packed: convert a padded 3D tensor into a packed tensor by removing padding using split sizes or a pad value
